UNITED STATES DISTRICT COURT
FOR THE EASTERN DISTRICT OF VIRGINIA
ALEXANDRIA DIVISION
MARVELLE J. BALLENTINE,
Plaintiff,
Case No. 1:26-cv-02331
V.
KATIE HALL, individually;
NATIONAL CENTER FOR MISSING & EXPLOITED
CHILDREN;
META PLATFORMS, INC.;
and JOHN/JANE DOES 1-6,
Defendants.
NOTICE OF HEARING ON PENDING OBJECTIONS AND MOTIONS BEFORE THE
DISTRICT JUDGE
PLEASE TAKE NOTICE that, pursuant to Local Civil Rule 7(E), Plaintiff Marvelle J.
Ballentine hereby notices for hearing the following pending matters before the Honorable Rossie
D. Alston, Jr., United States District Judge, at the Albert V. Bryan United States Courthouse, 401
Courthouse Square, Alexandria, Virginia 22314, on Wednesday, December 16, 2026, at 10:00
a.m., or as soon thereafter as the matters may be heard:
Plaintiff's Rule 72(a) Objections to the Order of October 7, 2026 (ECF No. 84)
(ECF No. 89);
Plaintiff's Motion to Set Aside the Amendment and Discovery Denials and for
Coordinated Determination of the Pending Objections in re the Order of October 7, 2026 (ECF
No. 84) (ECF No. 90);
1

3.
Plaintiff's Motion for Targeted Vacatur of ECF Nos. 64 and 84, Withdrawal or
Modification of the Magistrate-Judge Referral, and Related Interim Relief (ECF No. 93);
Plaintiff's Rule 72(a) Objections to the Order of October 22, 2026 (ECF No. 96)
(ECF No. 97); and
Plaintiff's Motion to Set Aside or Modify ECF No. 96, Determine Reassignment
Authority, and Grant Leave to Supplement ECF No. 93 (ECF No. 98).
Plaintiff notices these matters together so that the Court may hear them on one date. Each
remains a separate matter with its own requested relief. Plaintiff does not request consolidation of
any matter with any other.
To the extent Plaintiff previously waived oral argument or requested submission on the
papers as to any matter listed above, Plaintiff withdraws that waiver as to that matter and requests
oral argument.
This Notice does not apply to ECF Nos. 66, 67, and 76, on which Plaintiff's waiver of oral
argument (ECF No. 85) stands.
LOCAL CIVIL RULE 7(E) STATEMENT
Plaintiff conferred by telephone with counsel for Defendants National Center for Missing
& Exploited Children and Katie Hall on November 2, 2026, at 3:00 p.m. Eastern. The conference
did not narrow the issues.
Date: November 2, 2026
Respectfully submitted,
Marvelle J. Ballentine
Plaintiff, pro se
1520 Belle View Blvd, Ste. #5847
Alexandria, Virginia 22307
(407) 794-6503
jayballentine@protonmail.com
